name: Amazon SES
label: Amazon SES — AWS SESv2 SendEmail
description: Amazon SES via the official AWS SESv2 REST API. Base https://email.{region}.amazonaws.com signed with AWS SigV4 (service ses). Docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/APIReference-V2/API_SendEmail.html. Sandbox until production access. Auth secrets access_key_id, secret_access_key, optional session_token are instance config only. listen = SNS/configuration-set events as BPMN message events. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Amazon SES operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"send-email"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-email | send-templated-email | create-template | get-template | list-templates | update-template | delete-template | create-custom-verification-template | get-custom-verification-template | list-custom-verification-templates | update-custom-verification-template | delete-custom-verification-template | create-identity | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: FromEmailAddress
schema.description: Verified From identity for send-email / send-templated-email and custom verification templates. Example: Ada <ada@example.com>.

schema.label: Destination
schema.description: SESv2 Destination envelope escape hatch. Purpose fields ToAddresses/CcAddresses/BccAddresses merge as Destination.* via bodyMap. Example: {"ToAddresses":["ada@example.com"]}.

schema.label: ToAddresses
schema.description: To addresses on send-email / send-templated-email. Nested as Destination.ToAddresses. Example: ["ada@example.com"].

schema.label: CcAddresses
schema.description: Cc addresses on send-email / send-templated-email. Nested as Destination.CcAddresses. Example: ["cc@example.com"].

schema.label: BccAddresses
schema.description: Bcc addresses on send-email / send-templated-email. Nested as Destination.BccAddresses. Example: ["bcc@example.com"].

schema.label: Content
schema.description: SES v2 Content for send-email (Simple) or send-templated-email (Template). Simple: {Simple:{Subject:{Data},Body:{Text:{Data},Html:{Data}}}}. Template: {Template:{TemplateName,TemplateData}} where TemplateData is a JSON-encoded STRING of variable values (send it here; TemplateName may come from the TemplateName field). Example Simple: {"Simple":{"Subject":{"Data":"Hi"},"Body":{"Text":{"Data":"Hello"}}}}. Example Template: {"Template":{"TemplateData":"{\"name\":\"Ana\"}"}}.

schema.label: TemplateName
schema.description: Template name for create/get/update/delete-template and send-templated-email (wired to Content.Template.TemplateName on send). Example: welcome.

schema.label: EmailIdentity
schema.description: Domain or email for create-identity. Example: example.com.

schema.label: ConfigurationSetName
schema.description: Optional configuration set for send-email / send-templated-email. Example: transactional.

schema.label: TemplateContent
schema.description:
Template content. create-template / update-template (required): object {Subject, Html, Text}, e.g. {"Subject":"Hi","Text":"Hello","Html":"

Hello

"}. create/update-custom-verification-template (required): the HTML body as a string, e.g.

Click to verify

.

schema.label: PageSize
schema.description: Page size for list-templates / list-custom-verification-templates. Example: 20.

schema.label: NextToken
schema.description: Pagination token for list-templates / list-custom-verification-templates.

schema.label: TemplateSubject
schema.description: Subject line for create/update-custom-verification-template (required there). Example: Verify your email.

schema.label: SuccessRedirectionURL
schema.description: URL the recipient is redirected to after successful verification; required by create/update-custom-verification-template. Example: https://example.com/verified.

schema.label: FailureRedirectionURL
schema.description: URL the recipient is redirected to when verification fails; required by create/update-custom-verification-template. Example: https://example.com/verify-failed.

schema.label: ReplyToAddresses
schema.description: Top-level ReplyToAddresses for send-email / send-templated-email. JSON array of emails. Example: ["noreply@example.com"].

schema.label: FeedbackForwardingEmailAddress
schema.description: Verified address that receives bounces/complaints for send-email / send-templated-email. Example: bounce@example.com.

schema.label: EmailTags
schema.description: EmailTags [{Name,Value}] for send-email / send-templated-email. Example: [{"Name":"campaign","Value":"welcome"}].

schema.label: TemplateData
schema.description: Template variable values JSON for send-templated-email. Wired to Content.Template.TemplateData. Example: {"name":"Ada"}.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-email, send-templated-email, create-template, get-template, list-templates, update-template, delete-template, create-custom-verification-template, get-custom-verification-template, list-custom-verification-templates, update-custom-verification-template, delete-custom-verification-template, create-identity, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: AWS access key
configurationParameters.description: IAM access key ID used as the SigV4 credential. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Prefer IAM least privilege ses:SendEmail. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: region
configurationParameters.description: AWS region for https://email.{region}.amazonaws.com (SESv2). Example: us-east-1. Required for SigV4.

configurationParameters.label: Aws Secret Access Key
configurationParameters.description: IAM secret access key for SigV4 signing (StudioQuack secret). Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: AWS session token
configurationParameters.description: Optional STS session token. When set, OfficialApiNode adds x-amz-security-token. Empty for long-lived keys. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: ConfigurationSetName
configurationParameters.description: Default ConfigurationSetName on send-email / send-templated-email when INPUT omits it.

configurationParameters.label: Templatedata
configurationParameters.description: Template variable values JSON for send-templated-email. Wired to Content.Template.TemplateData. Example: {"name":"Ada"}.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: FromEmailAddress
configurationParameters.description: Default verified sender when INPUT FromEmailAddress is empty.
